$comment: Coldline Task 4.4 public answer contract. Three answers about the one supplied handling note the supplied redactor handles wrongly: which note it is, whether the redactor missed marked PII (false_negative) or removed text that is not PII (false_positive), and which entry in the limitations section of docs/security/redactor.md describes that pattern. The public check validates this shape and that each value is one the supplied material names; the protected answer check compares the values after the submission on the platform. There is no self-attestation field, no pass boolean, and no recording URL. The id lists repeat tests/fixtures/pii/notes.yaml and docs/security/redactor.md; a contract test keeps them aligned.
title: Coldline Task 4.4 answers
description: The mishandled note, the kind of error, and the documented limitation behind it.

answers.description: The only top-level answer mapping accepted by the public verifier.

limitation_note.description: The id of the one supplied note in tests/fixtures/pii/notes.yaml whose redacted text does not match the PII values its fixture marks.

limitation_type.description: false_negative when the redactor left marked PII in place; false_positive when it removed text the fixture does not mark as PII.

documented_limitation.description: The id of the entry in the limitations section of docs/security/redactor.md that describes the pattern behind that note.
